description: This file declares functions and data structures related to traversing and marking reachable objects in a version control system, likely Git. It defines function prototypes for adding recent objects to traversal and marking objects as reachable, along with struct types and a callback function type.

methods.name: add_unseen_recent_objects_to_traversal
methods.description: Adds unseen recent objects to the traversal process based on a timestamp, utilizing a callback to report objects.

methods.name: mark_reachable_objects
methods.description: Marks objects as reachable based on revision info, reflog, timestamps, and progress tracking.

ctags.name: report_recent_object_fn
ctags.pattern: /^typedef void report_recent_object_fn(const struct object *, struct packed_git *,$/
